1.explanation:
This minimal React example brings in Carbon’s CSS, then renders:

• An <ul> with className="bx--accordion bx--skeleton" and three <li> items. Each item contains a <button className="bx--accordion__heading" /> with no text or aria-label, so DAP flags it as missing a label.

• A standalone <button className="bx--btn bx--skeleton" /> with no visible text or aria-label, also triggering the same violation.

Load this app in Chrome and run the IBM DAP audit: you will see exactly the “Form control element button is missing associated label” errors shown in your screenshots.
1.bug_scenario: When you render the “Accordion” and standalone “Button” skeleton variants in Carbon React, the outer markup contains <button> elements with no visible text or aria-label. Running the IBM DAP audit on that page flags each of those <button> form controls as “missing associated label.” In the screenshot you can see repeated DAP errors like “Form control element button is missing associated label” for each skeleton accordion heading and skeleton button.
